Precursor to 20 satellite constellation for AIS and Earth observation.
Description

Precursor to 20 satellite constellation planned for 2018. 12MP panchromatic optical payload and AIS bent-pipe capabilities. Eaglet-1 is the in-orbit validation of a nanosatellite developed using the industrial approach. It is characterized by reliability and performance, and is the precursor to a constellation of highly innovative, fast-to-deploy and cost-effective satellites that provide optical and AIS data.
